title: Occupancy forecast
description: Published once per room day, retained, by the occupancy forecast process to MQTT topic occupancy/<room>/forecast.

room_id.description: Room identifier, matching BuildSim's room key.

date.description: The local calendar date the forecast covers (YYYY-MM-DD).

slot_minutes.description: Length of each slot, in minutes.

slots.description: Expected head count per slot of the day, in time order. A slot with no stored history is left out, so the list is empty before the first weekday of history.

people.description: Expected number of people in the room during the slot.
